8 ارتوى : see 1, first and third sentences: ―
-b2- and see also 5, in two places. ―
-b3- ارتوت النَّخْلَةُ The palm-tree, having been planted in a hollow dug for the purpose, was watered at its root. (Lth, T.) ＝
-A2- It (a rope) was twisted: (M, K:) or was twisted well, or thoroughly, or soundly: (M:) or was thick in its strands: (S:) or was composed of many strands, and thick, and very compact. (Lth, T.) ―
-b2- And ارتوت مَفَاصِلُهُ His joints (those of a beast, T, or those of a man, S) were, or became, well-proportioned and thick; (T, S, K;) and so ↓ تروّت . (M, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
